purpose: Platform-family grouping for state/territory adapter deployment. Groups are implementation hypotheses until a session verifies the actual endpoint/platform.
fallback_protocol: Probe the assigned source briefly before writing adapter code.
If the actual platform differs, stop implementation work for that source.
Update coord/state_platform_tracker.md under coord/lock with status=reclassified, actual_platform_family, reclassified_to, evidence, and latest_result.
If changing machine-readable grouping, update data/state_platform_groups.json in the same locked edit and validate JSON.
Do not force a brittle adapter into the wrong platform family.

sources.target_api: Blocked Proactis/WebProcure route: CTsource embeds https://webprocure.proactiscloud.com/wp-web-public with _wpcall=bidboard and _customerid=51; no official CTsource alternate API/feed/doc route found; vendor base/assets fail standard TLS and curl -k times out with 0 bytes. Legacy BizNet fallback checked: https://biznet.ct.gov/SCP_Search/Default.aspx redirects to CTsource landing; BidResults.aspx and BidDetail.aspx return 200 but no search-session criteria, direct/common query params return 0/No Solicitations Found, and no stable public listing API or searchable route was found.
sources.notes: Official CTsource Bid Board/resources/login pages return 200 but only expose UI/embed routes. Linked CTsource PDFs describe UI search and supplier workflows only. WhiteLabel.js and FrameManager.js are not reachable from CLI with standard TLS; insecure probes timed out with 0 bytes. No adapter registered. Legacy BizNet fallback checked: https://biznet.ct.gov/SCP_Search/Default.aspx redirects to CTsource landing; BidResults.aspx and BidDetail.aspx return 200 but no search-session criteria, direct/common query params return 0/No Solicitations Found, and no stable public listing API or searchable route was found.

reclassification_signals: Official page injects webprocure.proactiscloud.com/wp-web-public assets.
Inline _wprocure config includes _wpcall=bidboard or contractboard and a customer id.
